Jun: Heads-up — seeing repeated NVLink + PCIe DMA pressure on shared-pool-usw2-12 during tenant bursts. 95p token latency +120ms. Window: 2026-03-21 11:02 UTC. :triangular_flag_on_post:
Priya: Which tenants and request shape?
Jun: t-sirocco + t-cyclone. Lots of small parallel streams (seq <=48), high kvcache churn, NVLink peer-to-peer saturated ~88-95%.
Sanjay: If it's P2P NVLink chatter, cross-rack routing won't cut it. Two levers: short-term soft-shape; mid-term ephemeral carveout with reserved NVLink headroom.
Lina: Soft-shape flow ok if we can guarantee transparent rollback and audit logs. CS will want to know if we throttle.
Jun: I prototyped a detection rule + soft-shape in staging: rule = nvlink_util > 0.8 && tenant_kv_miss_rate > 0.55 over 2m -> tag + apply egress policer for 45s. Worked on staging, tail dropped.
Jun: Policer snippet we used:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/tenants/t-sirocco/policer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"egress_tps":150,"burst":300,"duration_s":45}'
```
Priya: Good. We need a dry-run in prod (no enforcement) for 48h to measure false positives. Add label reason `nvlink_kv_churn` for auditing.
Sanjay: Agree. Also add ramp detection to avoid warmup storms: require sustained for 3m OR 2 triggers within 10m.
Lina: For mid-term carveouts, finance needs a daily estimate. Preliminary: ephemeral 8xA100 prewarmed ~ $550/day. Need exact quoting.
Priya: I'll ask finance. Also CS wants opt-in early: suggest we email affected customers offering dedicated slice trial with monitoring.
Jun: Another mitigation: runtime fallback to low-kv model variant for affected tenants. That reduces cross-GPU KV traffic without moving hardware.
Sanjay: We have lighter variants for main gen models. Need runtime routing rule: if tenant_tag=egress_heavy -> prefer variant=kv-lite.
Lina: Add audit/logging for any auto-action: tag creation, policer applied, routing switch. CS/Legal will insist for customer-impact traces.
Jun: ops-bot created INC-20260321-7 and attached runbook link.
ops-bot: INC-20260321-7 created; paging routed to oncall.
Priya: Action items:
- Jun: run 48h dry-run alert in prod (dry-run, no enforcement) and collect hits (ETA: today)
- SAnjay: PR to noise-detector for labeling + soft-shape executor + ramp logic (ETA: EOD)
- Lina: draft CS notice + coordinate finance quote (ETA: tomorrow)
- Priya: add audit logging spec and retention policy for labels/actions (ETA: 48h)
Sanjay: Also will add metric to track rollback frequency to ensure we don't flip-flop.
Jun: If dry-run shows >3 false positives/day, we tighten thresholds. If sustained offenders found, we will propose ephemeral carveout + prewarm and a billing/credits plan.
Lina: Can we mark carveouts as "trial" so customers aren't billed automatically? Ops/Finance need to support that.
Priya: We'll propose trial credits for first 7 days; Finance to confirm.
Jun: Thanks — I'll post updates to #eng-infra after 48h dry-run. :memo:
